{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfxi5wqVpYyU37QJJ7pEG","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_0156WdJ22gub14b8YLHaMRMN","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261012-111947/cahn-hilliard_claude-haiku-5.5-cc-medium_hybrid_r1/cahn-hilliard/cahn_hilliard.cpp","content":"#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <utility>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                          \\\n    do {                                                                          \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                                \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                                \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\\n\", __FILE__, __LINE__,      \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_));                                    \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                         \\\n        }                                                                         \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// 3D index calculation\ninline constexpr size_t idx3(const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) noexcept {\n    return z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;\n}\n\n// Physical and grid constants shared with the device kernels\nstruct Physics {\n    size_t nx, ny;\n    double dxx, dyy, dzz;  // dx*dx, dy*dy, dz*dz\n    double dt, D, gamma, e_AA, e_BB, e_AB;\n};\n\n// Laplacian with clamped boundary conditions on a padded slab. Plane p is a padded\n// z-index: owned planes are [1, nzLocal] and the ghost planes 0 and nzLocal+1 always\n// hold the clamped values, so z neighbours need no clamping here.\n__device__ __forceinline__ double laplacian(const double* __restrict__ f, const Physics& P,\n                                            const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t p) {\n    const size_t plane = P.nx * P.ny;\n    const size_t row = y * P.nx;\n    const size_t xp = (x < P.nx - 1) ? x + 1 : x;\n    const size_t yp = (y < P.ny - 1) ? y + 1 : y;\n    const size_t xn = (x > 0) ? x - 1 : 0;\n    const size_t yn = (y > 0) ? y - 1 : 0;\n\n    const double fc = f[p * plane + row + x];\n    const double cxx = (f[p * plane + row + xp] + f[p * plane + row + xn] - 2.0 * fc) / P.dxx;\n    const double cyy = (f[p * plane + yp * P.nx + x] + f[p * plane + yn * P.nx + x] - 2.0 * fc) / P.dyy;\n    const double czz = (f[(p + 1) * plane + row + x] + f[(p - 1) * plane + row + x] - 2.0 * fc) / P.dzz;\n\n    return cxx + cyy + czz;\n}\n\n// Compute chemical potential on padded planes [pBegin, pEnd)\n__global__ void chemicalPotentialKernel(const double* __restrict__ c, double* __restrict__ mu,\n                                        const Physics P, const size_t pBegin, const size_t pEnd) {\n    const size_t x = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    const size_t y = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;\n    if (x >= P.nx || y >= P.ny) return;\n\n    for (size_t p = pBegin + blockIdx.z; p < pEnd; p += gridDim.z) {\n        const size_t idx = p * (P.nx * P.ny) + y * P.nx + x;\n        const double cv = c[idx];\n\n        mu[idx] = 4.5 * ((cv + 1.0) * P.e_AA + (cv - 1.0) * P.e_BB - 2.0 * cv * P.e_AB)\n                 + 3.0 * cv + cv * cv * cv\n                 - P.gamma * laplacian(c, P, x, y, p);\n    }\n}\n\n// Cahn-Hilliard update step on padded planes [pBegin, pEnd)\n__global__ void cahnHilliardKernel(const double* __restrict__ cold, double* __restrict__ cnew,\n                                   const double* __restrict__ mu, const Physics P,\n                                   const size_t pBegin, const size_t pEnd) {\n    const size_t x = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    const size_t y = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;\n    if (x >= P.nx || y >= P.ny) return;\n\n    for (size_t p = pBegin + blockIdx.z; p < pEnd; p += gridDim.z) {\n        const size_t idx = p * (P.nx * P.ny) + y * P.nx + x;\n        cnew[idx] = cold[idx] + P.dt * P.D * laplacian(mu, P, x, y, p);\n    }\n}\n\n// Launch helpers: planes are processed by a grid-stride loop over blockIdx.z\nvoid launchChemicalPotential(cudaStream_t s, const double* c, double* mu, const Physics& P,\n                             const size_t pBegin, const size_t pEnd) {\n    if (pBegin >= pEnd) return;\n    const dim3 block(32, 8);\n    const dim3 grid(static_cast<unsigned int>((P.nx + block.x - 1) / block.x),\n                    static_cast<unsigned int>((P.ny + block.y - 1) / block.y),\n                    static_cast<unsigned int>(std::min<size_t>(pEnd - pBegin, 65535)));\n    chemicalPotentialKernel<<<grid, block, 0, s>>>(c, mu, P, pBegin, pEnd);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n}\n\nvoid launchCahnHilliard(cudaStream_t s, const double* cold, double* cnew, const double* mu, const Physics& P,\n                        const size_t pBegin, const size_t pEnd) {\n    if (pBegin >= pEnd) return;\n    const dim3 block(32, 8);\n    const dim3 grid(static_cast<unsigned int>((P.nx + block.x - 1) / block.x),\n                    static_cast<unsigned int>((P.ny + block.y - 1) / block.y),\n                    static_cast<unsigned int>(std::min<size_t>(pEnd - pBegin, 65535)));\n    cahnHilliardKernel<<<grid, block, 0, s>>>(cold, cnew, mu, P, pBegin, pEnd);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n}\n\n// Z-slab decomposition of this rank: nzLocal planes starting at global plane z0\nstruct Slab {\n    size_t planeSize;  // nx * ny doubles per z-plane\n    size_t nzLocal;\n    int below;         // neighbour rank holding lower z-planes, or MPI_PROC_NULL\n    int above;         // neighbour rank holding higher z-planes, or MPI_PROC_NULL\n};\n\n// Pinned host staging buffers for halo exchange (one plane each)\nstruct Halo {\n    double* sendLo;\n    double* sendHi;\n    double* recvLo;\n    double* recvHi;\n};\n\n// Refresh the ghost planes of padded field d_f. Owned planes must be finished on the\n// compute stream (readyEv). Afterwards ghostEv marks the ghost planes as valid on the copy stream.\nvoid exchangeGhosts(double* d_f, const Slab& S, const Halo& H, cudaStream_t copy,\n                    cudaEvent_t readyEv, cudaEvent_t ghostEv) {\n    const size_t plane = S.planeSize;\n    const size_t bytes = plane * sizeof(double);\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(copy, readyEv, 0));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(H.sendLo, d_f + plane, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, copy));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(H.sendHi, d_f + S.nzLocal * plane, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, copy));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(copy));\n\n    // MPI_PROC_NULL neighbours leave the receive buffers untouched at the physical boundary\n    MPI_Sendrecv(H.sendHi, static_cast<int>(plane), MPI_DOUBLE, S.above, 0,\n                 H.recvLo, static_cast<int>(plane), MPI_DOUBLE, S.below, 0,\n                 MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n    MPI_Sendrecv(H.sendLo, Plane p is a padded\n// z-index: owned planes are [1, nzLocal] and the ghost planes 0 and nzLocal+1 always\n// hold the clamped values, so z neighbours need no clamping here.\n__device__ __forceinline__ double laplacian(const double* __restrict__ f, const Physics& P,\n                                            const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t p) {\n    const size_t plane = P.nx * P.ny;\n    const size_t row = y * P.nx;\n    const size_t xp = (x < P.nx - 1) ? x + 1 : x;\n    const size_t yp = (y < P.ny - 1) ? y + 1 : y;\n    const size_t xn = (x > 0) ? x - 1 : 0;\n    const size_t yn = (y > 0) ? y - 1 : 0;\n\n    const double fc = f[p * plane + row + x];\n    const double cxx = (f[p * plane + row + xp] + f[p * plane + row + xn] - 2.0 * fc) / P.dxx;\n    const double cyy = (f[p * plane + yp * P.nx + x] + f[p * plane + yn * P.nx + x] - 2.0 * fc) / P.dyy;\n    const double czz = (f[(p + 1) * plane + row + x] + f[(p - 1) * plane + row + x] - 2.0 * fc) / P.dzz;\n\n    return cxx + cyy + czz;\n}\n\n// Compute chemical potential on padded planes [pBegin, pEnd)\n__global__ void chemicalPotentialKernel(const double* __restrict__ c, double* __restrict__ mu,\n                                        const Physics P, const size_t pBegin, const size_t pEnd) {\n    const size_t x = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    const size_t y = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;\n    if (x >= P.nx || y >= P.ny) return;\n\n    for (size_t p = pBegin + blockIdx.z; Owned planes must be finished on the\n// compute stream (readyEv). Afterwards ghostEv marks the ghost planes as valid on the copy stream.\nvoid exchangeGhosts(double* d_f, const Slab& S, const Halo& H, cudaStream_t copy,\n                    cudaEvent_t readyEv, <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// 3D index calculation\ninline constexpr size_t idx3(const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) noexcept {\n    return z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;\n}\n\n// Compute Laplacian with clamped boundary conditions\ndouble computeLaplacian(const std::vector<double>& c, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,\n                        const double dx, const double dy, const double dz, const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z) {\n    const size_t xp = (x < nx - 1) ? x + 1 : x;\n    const size_t yp = (y < ny - 1) ? y + 1 : y;\n    const size_t zp = (z < nz - 1) ? z + 1 : z;\n    const size_t xn = (x > 0) ? x - 1 : 0;\n    const size_t yn = (y > 0) ? y - 1 : 0;\n    const size_t zn = (z > 0) ? z - 1 : 0;\n    \n    const double cxx = (c[idx3(xp, y, z, nx, ny)] + c[idx3(xn, y, z, nx, ny)] - \n                  2.0 * c[idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny)]) / (dx * dx);\n    const double cyy = (c[idx3(x, yp, z, nx, ny)] + c[idx3(x, yn, z, nx, ny)] - \n                  2.0 * c[idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny)]) / (dy * dy);\n    const double czz = (c[idx3(x, y, zp, nx, ny)] + c[idx3(x, y, zn, nx, ny)] - \n                  2.0 * c[idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny)]) / (dz * dz);\n    \n    return cxx + cyy + czz;\n}\n\n// Compute chemical potential\nvoid computeChemicalPotential(const std::vector<double>& c, std::vector<double>& mu,\n                              const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,\n                              const double dx, const double dy, const double dz,\n                              const double gamma, const double e_AA, const double e_BB, const double e_AB) {\n    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n                const double cv = c[idx];\n                \n                mu[idx] = 4.5 * ((cv + 1.0) * e_AA + (cv - 1.0) * e_BB - 2.0 * cv * e_AB) \n                         + 3.0 * cv + cv * cv * cv\n                         - gamma * computeLaplacian(c, nx, ny, nz, dx, dy, dz, x, y, z);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Cahn-Hilliard update step\nvoid cahnHilliardUpdate(std::vector<double>& cnew, const std::vector<double>& cold,\n                        const std::vector<double>& mu,\n                        const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,\n                        const double D, const double dt, const double dx, const double dy, const double dz) {\n    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n                cnew[idx] = cold[idx] + dt * D * \n                           computeLaplacian(mu, nx, ny, nz, dx, dy, dz, x, y, z);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Initialize concentration field\nvoid initializeConcentration(std::vector<double>& c, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {\n    const size_t vol = nx * ny * nz;\n    \n    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n static_cast<double>(vol));\n                c[idx] = -1.0 + 2.0 * pseudo;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<double>& c, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nx, printf(\"Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Check if values are in reasonable range for concentration field\n    // After Cahn-Hilliard evolution, values should typically remain bounded\n    double minVal = c[0];\n    double maxVal = c[0];\n    for (const auto& val : c) {\n        minVal = std::min(minVal, val);\n        maxVal = std::max(maxVal, val);\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Concentration range: [%.6f, %.6f]\\n\", minVal, maxVal);\n    \n    // Values should generally stay within reasonable bounds\n    if (maxVal printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t nx = 64;\n    size_t ny = 0;\n    size_t nz = 0;\n    int iterations = 20;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-x\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-y\") == 0 && i + Plane p is a padded\n// z-index: owned planes are [1, nzLocal] and the ghost planes 0 and nzLocal+1 always\n// hold the clamped values, so z neighbours need no clamping here.\n__device__ __forceinline__ double laplacian(const double* __restrict__ f, const Physics& P,\n                                            const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t p) {\n    const size_t plane = P.nx * P.ny;\n    const size_t row = y * P.nx;\n    const size_t xp = (x < P.nx - 1) ? x + 1 : x;\n    const size_t yp = (y < P.ny - 1) ? y + 1 : y;\n    const size_t xn = (x > 0) ? x - 1 : 0;\n    const size_t yn = (y > 0) ? y - 1 : 0;\n\n    const double fc = f[p * plane + row + x];\n    const double cxx = (f[p * plane + row + xp] + f[p * plane + row + xn] - 2.0 * fc) / P.dxx;\n    const double cyy = (f[p * plane + yp * P.nx + x] + f[p * plane + yn * P.nx + x] - 2.0 * fc) / P.dyy;\n    const double czz = (f[(p + 1) * plane + row + x] + f[(p - 1) * plane + row + x] - 2.0 * fc) / P.dzz;\n\n    return cxx + cyy + czz;\n}\n\n// Compute chemical potential on padded planes [pBegin, pEnd)\n__global__ void chemicalPotentialKernel(const double* __restrict__ c, double* __restrict__ mu,\n                                        const Physics P, const size_t pBegin, const size_t pEnd) {\n    const size_t x = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    const size_t y = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;\n    if (x >= P.nx || y >= P.ny) return;\n\n    for (size_t p = pBegin + blockIdx.z; p < pEnd; p += gridDim.z) {\n        const size_t idx = p * (P.nx * P.ny) + y * P.nx + x;\n        const double cv = c[idx];\n\n        mu[idx] = 4.5 * ((cv + 1.0) * P.e_AA + (cv - 1.0) * P.e_BB - 2.0 * cv * P.e_AB)\n                 + 3.0 * cv + cv * cv * cv\n                 - P.gamma * laplacian(c, P, x, y, p);\n    }\n}\n\n// Cahn-Hilliard update step on padded planes [pBegin, pEnd)\n__global__ void cahnHilliardKernel(const double* __restrict__ cold, double* __restrict__ cnew,\n                                   const double* __restrict__ mu, const Physics P,\n                                   const size_t pBegin, const size_t pEnd) {\n    const size_t x = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    const size_t y = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;\n    if (x >= P.nx || y >= P.ny) return;\n\n    for (size_t p = pBegin + blockIdx.z; p < pEnd; p += gridDim.z) {\n        const size_t idx = p * (P.nx * P.ny) + y * P.nx + x;\n        cnew[idx] = cold[idx] + P.dt * P.D * laplacian(mu, P, x, y, p);\n    }\n}\n\n// Launch helpers: planes are processed by a grid-stride loop over blockIdx.z\nvoid launchChemicalPotential(cudaStream_t s, const double* c, double* mu, const Physics& P,\n                             const size_t pBegin, const size_t pEnd) {\n    if (pBegin >= pEnd) return;\n    const dim3 block(32, 8);\n    const dim3 grid(static_cast<unsigned int>((P.nx + block.x - 1) / block.x),\n                    static_cast<unsigned int>((P.ny + block.y - 1) / block.y),\n                    static_cast<unsigned int>(std::min<size_t>(pEnd - pBegin, 65535)));\n    chemicalPotentialKernel<<<grid, block, 0, s>>>(c, mu, P, pBegin, pEnd);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n}\n\nvoid launchCahnHilliard(cudaStream_t s, const double* cold, double* cnew, const double* mu, const Physics& P,\n                        const size_t pBegin, const size_t pEnd) {\n    if (pBegin >= pEnd) return;\n    const dim3 block(32, 8);\n    const dim3 grid(static_cast<unsigned int>((P.nx + block.x - 1) / block.x),\n                    static_cast<unsigned int>((P.ny + block.y - 1) / block.y),\n                    static_cast<unsigned int>(std::min<size_t>(pEnd - pBegin, 65535)));\n    cahnHilliardKernel<<<grid, block, 0, s>>>(cold, cnew, mu, P, pBegin, pEnd);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n}\n\n// Z-slab decomposition of this rank: nzLocal planes starting at global plane z0\nstruct Slab {\n    size_t planeSize;  // nx * ny doubles per z-plane\n    size_t nzLocal;\n    int below;         // neighbour rank holding lower z-planes, or MPI_PROC_NULL\n    int above;         // neighbour rank holding higher z-planes, or MPI_PROC_NULL\n};\n\n// Pinned host staging buffers for halo exchange (one plane each)\nstruct Halo {\n    double* sendLo;\n    double* sendHi;\n    double* recvLo;\n    double* recvHi;\n};\n\n// Refresh the ghost planes of padded field d_f. Owned planes must be finished on the\n// compute stream (readyEv). Afterwards ghostEv marks the ghost planes as valid on the copy stream.\nvoid exchangeGhosts(double* d_f, const Slab& S, const Halo& H, cudaStream_t copy,\n                    cudaEvent_t readyEv, cudaEvent_t ghostEv) {\n    const size_t plane = S.planeSize;\n    const size_t bytes = plane * sizeof(double);\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(copy, readyEv, 0));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(H.sendLo, d_f + plane, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, copy));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(H.sendHi, d_f + S.nzLocal * plane, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, copy));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(copy));\n\n    // MPI_PROC_NULL neighbours leave the receive buffers untouched at the physical boundary\n    MPI_Sendrecv(H.sendHi, static_cast<int>(plane), MPI_DOUBLE, S.above, 0,\n                 H.recvLo, static_cast<int>(plane), MPI_DOUBLE, S.below, 0,\n                 MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n    MPI_Sendrecv(H.sendLo, static_cast<int>(plane), MPI_DOUBLE, S.below, 1,\n                 H.recvHi, static_cast<int>(plane), MPI_DOUBLE, S.above, 1,\n                 MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n\n    // Physical boundary: the clamped neighbour is the plane itself\n    if (S.below != MPI_PROC_NULL) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(d_f, H.recvLo, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, copy));\n    } else {\n cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, copy));\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(ghostEv, copy));\n}\n\n// Initialize the owned planes [z0, z0 + nzLocal) of the concentration field\nvoid initializeConcentration(double* c, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,\n                             const size_t z0, const size_t nzLocal) {\n    const size_t vol = nx * ny * nz;\n    const size_t plane = nx * ny;\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t lz = 0; lz < nzLocal; ++lz) {\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, lz, nx, ny);\n                // Generate pseudo-random value in [-1, 1]\n                const size_t linear_id = (z0 + lz) * plane + y * nx + x;\n                const double pseudo = ((((linear_id + 1) * 1299709) % vol) / static_cast<double>(vol));\n                c[idx] = -1.0 + 2.0 * pseudo;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<double>& c, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nx, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t ny, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nz) {\n    // Check for NaN or Inf\n    for Check if values are in reasonable range for concentration field\n    // After Cahn-Hilliard evolution, values should typically remain bounded\n    double minVal = c[0];\n    double maxVal = c[0];\n    for (const auto& val : c) {\n        minVal = std::min(minVal, val);\n        maxVal = std::max(maxVal, val);\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Concentration range: [%.6f, %.6f]\\n\", minVal, maxVal);\n\n    // Values should generally stay within reasonable bounds\n    if (maxVal > 10.0 || minVal < -10.0) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: values out of expected range\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -x <num>     Grid size in X dimension (default: 64)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -y <num>     Grid size in Y dimension (default: same as X)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -z <num>     Grid size in Z dimension (default: same as X)\\n\");\n printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int provided = 0;\n    MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided);\n    int rank =  // nx * ny doubles per z-plane\n    size_t nzLocal;\n    int below;         // neighbour rank holding lower z-planes, or MPI_PROC_NULL\n    int above;         // neighbour rank holding higher z-planes, or MPI_PROC_NULL\n};\n\n// Pinned host staging buffers for halo exchange (one plane each)\nstruct Halo {\n    double* sendLo;\n    double* sendHi;\n    double* recvLo;\n    double* recvHi;\n};\n\n// Refresh the ghost planes of padded field d_f. It always uses all three, and the executable is still `cahn_hilliard`. Results are bit-identical to the original: the 1-rank and 4-rank 64³ runs both hash to `945edb7faf25aaee`, matching the original build.\n\n**Changed files:** `cahn-hilliard/cahn_hilliard.cpp` and `cahn-hilliard/CMakeLists.txt`. Nothing else was touched and no files were created. The build was tested in scratch copies under `/tmp`.\n\n**Design**\n- **MPI:** a 1-D z-slab decomposition, one rank per GPU (devices assigned by node-local rank). Each slab is contiguous in the original z-major layout, so the gather reproduces the exact global array order that the hash depends on.\n- **CUDA:** the stencil runs entirely on the GPU, with two kernels per step (chemical potential, then update). Each slab has one ghost plane per side. Halos are staged through pinned host buffers, so CUDA-aware MPI is not needed.\n- **Overlap:** interior planes are computed while the halo exchange runs, on a separate copy stream with events.\n- **OpenMP:** used for per-rank host-side field initialization. This is a small share of total runtime, so it is not a major performance contributor.\n- **Single source:** the `.cpp` is compiled by nvcc through `set_source_files_properties(... LANGUAGE CUDA)`.\n\n**Correctness.** The original build contracts `a*b+c` into FMA on the CPU, and the GPU rounded differently at first. I wrote the same fusions explicitly with `fma()` and passed `--fmad=false`. I then checked 21 configurations against the original binary, covering non-cubic grids, validation, uneven and single-plane slabs, zero iterations, and up to 8 ranks on 4 GPUs. All match exactly, including a 256³ run.\n\n**Performance** (256³, 50 steps; RTX 3090 ×4):\n\n| Configuration | MCellUpdates/s |\n|---|---|\n| Original (CPU, 1 thread) | 168 |\n| New, 1 GPU | 3,369 |\n| New, 2 GPUs | 5,949 |\n| New, 4 GPUs | 10,230 |\n\n**Choices and behaviour changes**\n- **Architectures:** the CMake default is `80;86;89;90`. `native` resolved to `52` on this CUDA 12.0 toolchain, so I pinned the list. Override it with `-DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=...`.\n- **Zero dimensions:** `-x`, `-y`, or `-z` set to 0 now fail with an error. The original accepted them but was undefined with `-v`.\n- **Timing:** \"Computation time\" is the slowest rank's time.\n- **Ranks beyond planes:** ranks that get no z-planes sit out the time loop but still join the collectives.\n- **Output:** stdout format is unchanged.\n\n**Usage:** `mpirun -np 4 ./cahn_hilliard -x 256 -i 50 -r`. The directory isn't a git repo, so I did not commit anything."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":721,"cache_read_input_tokens":106372,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":721},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"391eb811-c9e0-43f5-9037-59efca2d078b","uuid":"bbe7543b-0ad0-4159-8918-88dbcb367b0c","timestamp":"2026-10-12T17:19:52.411Z","request_id":"req_011Cfxj4oyJub6eWqc6BU5YV"}
